Tether for coding agents

A native chat panel for coding agents inside JetBrains IDEs.

  • Source on GitHub
  • Releases
  • Documentation

What it is

Tether runs the Claude Code CLI, and Agent Client Protocol agents such as Hermes, in a tool window in the IDE. It uses the agents you already have installed and their existing logins, and never reads, stores or forwards credentials.

  • Several chats at once, each in its own tab, including chats in separate git worktrees.
  • Files the agent reads or edits are links, and every edit has a diff.
  • The agent sees your current file, selection and caret, and which files you edited or what you did in git between messages.
  • The agent can use the IDE's diagnostics, find usages, quick fixes and rename and move refactorings.
  • Errors in the agent's edits are reported back to it in the same turn.
  • Revert files, the conversation or both to how they were before any message.

Install

Tether needs a 2026.2 JetBrains IDE (build 262 or later) and Claude Code installed and logged in.

  1. In the IDE, open Settings → Plugins, click ⚙︎ and choose Manage Plugin Repositories…
  2. Add this URL: https://atlipall.github.io/tether/updatePlugins.xml
  3. Search the Marketplace tab for Tether, install it and restart the IDE.

New versions then appear as regular plugin updates in the IDE.
